svg.title: Gazebo + ros2_control architecture for the humanoid robot
svg.desc: Layered diagram showing how Gazebo, ros2_control, controllers, and ROS2 topics connect

g.text: balance_controller, imu_filter, IK node, ZMP controller (future)
reads all 18 joints → publishes /joint_states (used by RViz, TF, IK)
defined in humanoid.urdf.xacro — <ros2_control> block — 18 joints declared here
loaded by Gazebo at startup — connects physics joints to ros2_control interfaces

svg.text: sets joint torques / reads joint positions

g.text: DART physics engine — simulates gravity, collisions, joint dynamics, contact forces
translates Gazebo topics (gz.msgs) ↔ ROS2 topics (sensor_msgs) — also bridges /clock

svg.text: declares the 18 joints + <ros2_control> block + Gazebo plugin tag
tells controller_manager which controller type each name maps to
starts gz sim, spawns robot, starts bridge, spawns controllers in order
declares gz_ros2_control, ros_gz_sim, ros_gz_bridge as dependencies
reads URDF + /joint_states → publishes TF so RViz can visualize sim
